text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "Just when I was thinking everyone's so fast, they passed me in the blink of an eye!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
“Still, while I was running!
I could clearly hear the crowd cheering for me!”

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Like 'Do your best, Urara-chan!'
or 'Never give up!' and stuff!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: That's why I was able to give it my all right to the very end~!
